## Cincinnati Hotel — PDF ingestion
Called by the Node backend when the admin uploads a PDF.
1. Extract text from the PDF
2. Wipe the previous knowledge base (single-document rule)
3. Split into ~1,400-char overlapping chunks and store them
4. Save document metadata for the admin dashboard
